AmielJohn.title: The Snack Strategist
AmielJohn.lore: A warrior who believes the secret to victory lies not just in skill, but in proper nutrition timing. Has developed a complex battle-snacking rotation that somehow works. Credits every victory to the perfect jerky-to-combat ratio.
AmielJohn.reputation: The only member who brings more snacks than potions to raids

Joco.title: The Strategic Vice
Joco.lore: Right hand to the Guild Leader, Joco is known for turning chaotic situations into calculated victories. While others panic, Joco sees patterns. A master tactician who somehow makes sense of Goblok's wildest plans and transforms them into actual strategy.
Joco.reputation: The voice of reason that keeps the guild from complete anarchy

Azryth.title: Nightblade Philosopher
Azryth.lore: Strikes from the shadows while pondering the deeper meaning of combat. Has been known to pause mid-assassination to debate the ethics of surprise attacks. Enemies never know if they're about to be eliminated or engaged in philosophical discourse.
Azryth.reputation: Most likely to defeat you physically and mentally

Draxiimov.title: The Meme Lord
Draxiimov.lore: Weaponized internet culture into a legitimate combat style. Every attack comes with perfectly timed references that confuse enemies into submission. The battlefield is their stage, and cringe is their sword. Undefeated in psychological warfare.
Draxiimov.reputation: Banned from three enemy guilds for emotional damage

Goblok.title: The Unpredictable Leader
Goblok.lore: Guild Leader and master of controlled chaos. Leads with a unique combination of brilliant strategy and complete randomness that keeps both allies and enemies perpetually confused. GPS systems have given up trying to predict raid patterns. Despite the chaos, somehow always gets results.
Goblok.reputation: The only leader who can turn a disaster into a victory parade

Hesucrypto.title: The Crypto Vice King
Hesucrypto.lore: Vice Guild Leader and visionary investor who sees every battle as a market opportunity. Analyzes enemy HP bars like stock charts and treats loot drops as portfolio diversification. The bot's creator and patron saint of calculated risks. Lost more gold than the guild treasury but somehow still Vice Leader.
Hesucrypto.specialty: Economic warfare and investment-based combat theory
Hesucrypto.reputation: The reason guild funds are both invested and terrifying

Iguro.title: Portal Chaos Agent
Iguro.lore: Mastered the art of spatial manipulation with questionable results. Every attack teleports unpredictably, making them as dangerous to allies as to enemies. Has accidentally recruited three raid bosses to the guild through portal mishaps. The recruitment team loves them anyway.
Iguro.reputation: Simultaneously the best and worst at targeting

Inihaw.title: The BBQ Vice Commander
Inihaw.lore: Vice Guild Leader who turned defensive tactics into a culinary art form. Protects allies while simultaneously grilling enemies to perfection. Every battlefield becomes a barbecue, every raid a feast. Enemies die from heart disease before combat damage. The guild's morale and cholesterol are both at all-time highs.
Inihaw.reputation: The shield that also feeds you

Jalo.title: The Legendary Namesake
Jalo.lore: The legend himself - the member so iconic that the entire attendance bot bears his name. A walking encyclopedia of useless facts who somehow makes them tactically relevant. Once defeated a dragon by lecturing it about proper dental hygiene. The dragon fled in shame. This bot exists as tribute to his legendary status.
Jalo.reputation: The guild's living legend and bot inspiration

LXRDGRIM.title: The Brooding Reaper
LXRDGRIM.lore: Radiates an aura of darkness and existential dread that somehow comforts allies and terrifies enemies. Every attack carries the weight of a thousand dark thoughts. Enemies request therapy sessions after encounters. Brooding is not optional - it's mandatory and weaponized.

Byakko.title: The Roaring Terror
Byakko.lore: Believes volume equals victory and has the track record to prove it. Every attack comes with a deafening roar that breaks enemy morale and allied eardrums simultaneously. The guild provides earplugs. Enemies provide surrender documents. Intimidation tactics: maximum. Hearing safety: questionable.
Byakko.reputation: The reason the guild insurance covers hearing aids

Carrera.title: Speed Demon
Carrera.lore: Moves so fast that physics has filed a formal complaint. Attacks with incredible speed and style, though accuracy is a secondary concern. Even their own attacks can't keep up with their movement. The battlefield becomes a blur when they arrive. Effectiveness through overwhelming velocity.
Carrera.reputation: Faster than their own decision-making process

CheeseCakee.title: The Dessert Destroyer
CheeseCakee.lore: Weaponized baking into a legitimate combat art. Every attack is delicious, deadly, and surprisingly moist. Enemies die satisfied and diabetic. Has defeated more bosses through pastry than most members defeat through actual combat. The sweetest threat in the guild.
CheeseCakee.reputation: The only member whose attacks smell amazing

Chunchunmaru.title: The Legendary Blade
Chunchunmaru.lore: Wields a massive legendary sword with an absolutely ridiculous name. The name was chosen deliberately for psychological warfare - enemies die laughing before they can mount a defense. Strategy working perfectly. The sword is mighty, the name is questionable, the results are undeniable.
Chunchunmaru.reputation: Most powerful weapon with the silliest name

Daleee.title: The Accidental Savior
Daleee.lore: A mage whose spells do the opposite of what's intended, but somehow everything works out. Aims curses at bosses, accidentally grants immortality to teammates. The guild has stopped questioning it and just accepts the happy accidents. Chaos theory incarnate.
Daleee.reputation: Wrong in every way that matters, perfect in every way that counts

EoriuX.title: The Self-Wounded Shadow
EoriuX.lore: A master assassin with one critical flaw: attacking themselves more than the enemy. Owns more bandages than weapons and has the local healer on speed dial. Despite this, somehow still terrifying in combat. Enemies unsure if they should attack or offer medical assistance.
EoriuX.reputation: The guild's biggest customer for healing supplies

erwarrr.title: The Screaming Spellcaster
erwarrr.lore: Discovered that spell accuracy increases when volume compensates for precision. Casts magic while screaming at maximum volume. Enemies surrender not from damage but from the sheer desire for silence. Morale impact questionable, effectiveness undeniable.
erwarrr.reputation: The reason guild meetings are held outdoors

Evand3r.title: The Trinket Tactician
Evand3r.lore: Believes any object can be a weapon with enough magical conviction. Once defeated a raid boss using only a spoon. Refuses to explain the technique or the logistics. The spoon is now guild legend, mounted in the hall of fame. Still uses random objects in combat daily.
Evand3r.reputation: The reason the guild storage has a 'weapons?' section

Fever.title: Reality Glitch
Fever.lore: Radiates an aura of pure chaos that makes reality itself question its existence. Enemies enter the chaos field and forget why they're fighting. Allies forget what they're doing too, but somehow everyone on the guild side is fine with it. Reality.exe has permanently stopped responding.
Fever.reputation: Living proof that chaos can be weaponized

Hercules.title: The Dancing Death
Hercules.lore: Combines lethal combat with interpretive dance in ways that shouldn't work but absolutely do. Enemies die confused about whether they were attacked or entertained. The guild is equally confused but thoroughly impressed. Every battle is a performance, every kill a choreographed masterpiece.

IZANAGI.title: The Shadow Colossus
IZANAGI.lore: Wields massive power with three primary facial expressions: brood, brood harder, and the rare brood-with-slight-smile. Heroic in action, dramatic in presentation, consistent in brooding. Every swing carries the weight of untold darkness and excellent dramatic timing.
IZANAGI.reputation: Most reliable source of dark atmosphere

M1ssy.title: The Chaotic Snacker
M1ssy.lore: Prioritizes snacks over victory, chaos over strategy, and somehow makes it work. Will pause any battle for proper snack breaks. Enemies have learned to wait politely. Priorities firmly established: snacks first, chaos second, victory third. All three usually achieved.
M1ssy.reputation: The member with the best battle provisions

Maria.title: The Twin Debater
Maria.lore: Fights with fists and arguments simultaneously. In constant debate with twin Marsha11 over literally everything, especially loot distribution. Has won more arguments than landed punches, but winning both battles. The sibling rivalry fuels combat effectiveness somehow.
Maria.reputation: Half of the guild's most entertaining duo

Marsha11.title: The Twin Defender
Marsha11.lore: The other half of the legendary twin duo. Blocks attacks while arguing with Maria constantly. Their synchronized fighting is 50% combat effectiveness, 50% sibling rivalry, 100% entertainment value. Guild morale rises whenever they deploy together, mostly from the show.
Marsha11.reputation: The other half of the guild's best entertainment

Munchyy.title: The Polite Assassin
Munchyy.lore: Kills with deadly efficiency but maintains impeccable manners throughout. Sends handwritten apology notes with every elimination. Enemies die confused but feeling oddly respected. Has never missed a thank-you card. Deadliest member with the best etiquette.
Munchyy.reputation: Most polite killer in guild history

Nyegerls.title: The Accidental Hybrid
Nyegerls.lore: Multiclassed by accident and still doesn't know which class they actually are. Punches and casts spells with equal unpredictability. Enemies don't know what to expect. Nyegerls doesn't know what to expect. Somehow this creates perfect chaos and consistent victories.

PotatoCheese.title: The Carb Crusader
PotatoCheese.lore: Discovered that potatoes make excellent projectiles and moral support. Every attack provides allies with +10 carbs and +5 morale. Side effects include comfort, mild confusion, and sudden hunger. The guild's most nourishing combatant. Enemies defeated, teammates fed.
PotatoCheese.reputation: The reason the guild never goes hungry

Varys.title: The Whisper Network
Varys.lore: Knows every secret, shares them strategically at random moments. Guild gossip network administrator and information broker. Accuracy of information: 60%. Entertainment value: 100%. Strategic value: surprisingly high. Enemies fear what Varys knows. Allies fear what Varys might reveal.

xLunox.title: The Moonlit Performer
xLunox.lore: Cannot and will not attack without proper entrance music and ambiance. Every battle begins with a 3-5 minute dramatic entrance sequence. Enemies wait politely because the presentation is that good. Worth every second of delay. Style over speed, ambiance over efficiency.
xLunox.reputation: The guild's most dramatic entrance specialist

Ztig.title: The Friendly Fire Legend
Ztig.lore: Shoots with enthusiasm but questionable targeting. Friend or foe status unclear to their projectiles. Banned from three official raids, showed up anyway and somehow helped. Friendly fire rate: impressive. Accuracy: terrifying. Guild acceptance: unconditional. Team damage insurance: expensive.

Skadushy.title: The Darkness Devourer
Skadushy.lore: Fights shadows and consumes darkness between strikes. Enemies fundamentally confused by a warrior who eats their element. Nutritionists baffled by shadow-based diet. Combat effectiveness unquestionable. Dietary choices unexplainable. Still swinging that oversized blade with shadow-fueled strength.
Skadushy.reputation: The guild's most confusing dietary specialist

Mervzs.title: The Mysterious Collector
Mervzs.lore: Purpose unclear, methods questionable, results terrifying. Collects orbs of unknown origin and function. Maybe they're spells. Maybe they're decorative. The guild stopped asking after the third mysterious explosion. Definitely powerful, definitely dangerous, definitely not explaining anything.
Mervzs.reputation: The member nobody questions out of fear

Sweeney.title: The Alignment Enigma
Sweeney.lore: Friend or foe? The answer changes hourly. Loyalty alignment shifts like the wind. The guild maintains a full conspiracy board dedicated to tracking Sweeney's current allegiance. Board remains inconclusive. Probably fine. Maybe. Results suggest ally. Probably. Effectiveness undeniable. Trust level: variable.

Riku.title: The Wandering Blade
Riku.lore: Fights with the wisdom of someone who's seen too many battles and learned too few lessons. Every strike carries experience, every dodge carries muscle memory, every strategy carries the weight of 'that one time it worked.' The journey continues, the blade stays sharp, the confusion remains eternal.
Riku.reputation: The warrior who learns everything except planning

Maia.title: The Serene Storm
Maia.lore: Calm on the surface, absolute chaos underneath. Approaches every battle with zen-like tranquility before unleashing calculated devastation. Enemies mistake serenity for weakness until it's far too late. The guild's most deceptively peaceful member and most surprisingly destructive force.
Maia.reputation: Proof that calm waters run deep and deadly

Miang.title: The Silent Reckoning
Miang.lore: Speaks rarely, strikes decisively, plans constantly. Every word is calculated, every action purposeful. When Miang speaks, the guild listens. When Miang moves, enemies fall. The embodiment of 'actions speak louder than words' and 'silence is golden but violence is platinum.'
Miang.reputation: The quietest member with the loudest impact

Pinayflix.title: The Streaming Sensation
Pinayflix.lore: Treats every battle like a live performance for an invisible audience. Provides running commentary during raids, complete with sponsorship mentions and viewer shoutouts. Enemies confused by constant narration. Guild entertained by production value. Like, subscribe, and defeat the boss.
Pinayflix.specialty: Combat entertainment and live battle streaming

Helvenica.title: The Font of Power
Helvenica.lore: Fights with typography precision and design sensibility. Every attack formatted perfectly, every combo properly spaced. Believes combat effectiveness is directly related to aesthetic presentation. Has defeated enemies through sheer visual superiority. Comic Sans is banned from their presence.
Helvenica.reputation: The guild's most stylistically consistent fighter

Shawty.title: The Compact Devastator
Shawty.lore: Small in stature, overwhelming in power. Has perfected the art of being underestimated and then absolutely destroying that assumption. Enemies make the same mistake once. Only once. The guild's proof that the best things come in small, terrifying packages.
Shawty.reputation: The smallest member with the biggest impact

Jayzzzzzzz.title: The Sleepy Destroyer
Jayzzzzzzz.lore: Fights in a perpetual state of drowsiness but somehow remains devastatingly effective. Every attack delivered with maximum yawns and minimum effort. Enemies confused by lethargic efficiency. The guild's most energy-efficient combatant. Power naps between boss phases.
Jayzzzzzzz.reputation: Most likely to defeat you while half-asleep

Onirgerep.title: The Reverse Enigma
Onirgerep.lore: Everything about this member is backwards - name, strategy, combat style. Attacks in reverse, plans in retrograde, somehow achieves forward progress. The universe hasn't figured out how it works. Neither has the guild. Results speak for themselves, even if they speak backwards.
Onirgerep.reputation: The guild's most confusingly effective member

Enaira.title: The Storm Caller
Enaira.lore: Brings the fury of tempests to every battle. Enemies face not just a warrior but an entire weather system. Forecasts call for pain with a 100% chance of defeat. The guild's personal meteorological phenomenon. Side effects may include lightning, thunder, and sudden enemy evacuation.
Enaira.reputation: The reason enemies check the weather forecast

DEMIURGE.title: The Architect of Chaos
DEMIURGE.lore: Designs elaborate plans with godlike complexity and demonic execution. Every strategy a masterpiece, every tactic a work of dark art. Creates scenarios where enemies defeat themselves through the sheer brilliance of the setup. The guild's resident genius of controlled destruction.
DEMIURGE.reputation: The mind behind the guild's most complex victories

JeffEpstein.title: The Controversial Tactician
JeffEpstein.lore: Named controversially, fights effectively. Every battle raises questions, every victory raises eyebrows. The guild has learned not to ask about the name and just appreciate the combat results. Tactical effectiveness unquestionable, naming choices forever debatable.
JeffEpstein.reputation: The name everyone questions, the fighter nobody doubts

ladyhoho.title: The Laughing Warrior
ladyhoho.lore: Approaches every battle with infectious joy and devastating technique. Enemies hear laughter and assume weakness until they're already defeated. The guild's morale booster and enemy confusion generator. Proof that happiness is the best weapon and joy is terrifying in the right hands.
ladyhoho.reputation: The happiest member with the saddest enemies

Andromach3.title: The Cyber Sentinel
Andromach3.lore: Fights like a program executing flawless code. Every attack optimized, every defense compiled for maximum efficiency. Has turned combat into computational science. Enemies debug their strategy too late. The guild's most algorithmically perfect fighter.
Andromach3.reputation: The warrior who turned fighting into programming

卂几几.title: The Symbolic Force
卂几几.lore: Named in symbols, fights in legend. Communication transcends language, combat transcends understanding. Enemies confused by everything from name to tactics. Guild inspired by mysterious excellence. A warrior who proves you don't need to be understood to be unstoppable.
卂几几.reputation: The member whose name is harder to type than their hits are to avoid

PanCoco.title: The Coconut Commander
PanCoco.lore: Discovered that coconuts are both nutritious and surprisingly aerodynamic. Weaponized tropical fruit into a combat art form. Enemies defeated by nature's perfect projectile. The guild stays hydrated and enemies stay defeated. Tropical warfare at its finest.
PanCoco.reputation: The reason the guild smells like vacation

Ace.title: The Perfect Hand
Ace.lore: Plays every battle like a high-stakes card game where they always hold the winning hand. Bluffs enemies into submission, calls their attacks, and goes all-in when it matters. Never shows their full strategy. Always walks away victorious. The guild's luckiest unlucky gambler.
Ace.reputation: The member who turned combat into a card game and keeps winning

Rapadapa.title: The Rhythm Warrior
Rapadapa.lore: Fights to an internal beat that only they can hear. Every attack perfectly timed to mysterious rhythm, every dodge a dance move. Enemies can't predict the tempo. Guild can't hear the music. Everyone witnesses the devastating choreography. Combat as performance art.
Rapadapa.reputation: The warrior with the best internal soundtrack

lanZ6.title: The Calculated Chaos
lanZ6.lore: Balances perfect mathematical precision with absolute randomness in ways that shouldn't work but devastatingly do. Every attack calculated to six decimal places then executed with pure chaos energy. The guild's proof that order and disorder can coexist beautifully in combat.
lanZ6.reputation: The member who weaponized probability itself
